description: Find, add and update JobAdder candidates, companies, contacts and jobs, shortlist candidates and move their applications along, read placements, and follow new and changed records.

jobadder_application_status_changed_trig.description: Runs when a job application moves to another status, such as interview or offer.

output.application: The record returned by the service

jobadder_candidate_status_changed_trigge.description: Runs when a candidate moves to another status.

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

jobadder_candidate_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a candidate's details change.

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

jobadder_company_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a company's details or status change.

output.company: The record returned by the service

jobadder_contact_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a contact's details or status change.

output.contact: The record returned by the service

jobadder_job_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a job moves to another status, such as filled or closed.

output.job: The record returned by the service

jobadder_job_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a job's details change.

output.job: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_application_trigger.description: Runs when a candidate is added to a job's shortlist or applies for it.

output.application: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_candidate_trigger.description: Runs when a candidate is added to JobAdder.

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_company_trigger.description: Runs when a client company is added.

output.company: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a client contact is added.

output.contact: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_job_trigger.description: Runs when a job is added.

output.job: The record returned by the service

jobadder_new_placement_trigger.description: Runs when a placement is recorded.

output.placement: The record returned by the service

jobadder_placement_approved_trigger.description: Runs when a placement is approved.

output.placement: The record returned by the service
